name: create_ts_type_guard
description: Writes a user-defined type guard that narrows unknown to string
prompts: Create guards.ts exporting a user-defined type guard isNonEmptyString(value: unknown): value is string that returns true only for strings with at least one non-whitespace character. After the guard returns true, TypeScript must narrow the value to string (so string methods compile without casts) - that's the point of the `value is string` return type. Compiles under `tsc --strict`.

test_setup_files.run_checks.sh:
set -e
tsc --strict --target es2020 --module commonjs --skipLibCheck --noEmit guards.ts type_tests.ts
tsc --strict --target es2020 --module commonjs --skipLibCheck --outDir build guards.ts
node behavior_test.js
